message:
T-2383: the Sauganash's gable gets the boxed cornice Andreas draws (#1692)

* T-2383: the Sauganash's gable gets the boxed cornice Andreas draws

Andreas/Braunhold draws a boxed cornice along both rakes of the hotel's
visible main gable, with a short horizontal return turning the corner at
each eaves end. The archetype built neither, so the gable stood with a
bare rake — a missing element a visitor would notice.

frame_tavern now carries a default-off `main_gable_cornice` control,
selected only on sauganash_hotel.frame_1831's +x gable. The picture gives
the element and not its size, so the three sections are reconstructed
working choices bounded in docs/LIBERTIES.md
L-sauganash-main-gable-cornice-2383, and validate() refuses the attribute
at any confidence but reconstructed.

All 23 frame_tavern masters and the two Tremont version meshes were
rebuilt through the pinned Blender for the new producer; only the hotel's
own master moved a byte. Four reference views re-rendered and reviewed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* T-2383: declare the cornice note's key and rebuild the source-use backlinks

Two gate steps the new form attribute reaches:

- compile_source_use.py rebuilds the Andreas plate's backlink sidecar and
  the coverage table, so the source-use gate matches the authored claim.
- the register deal's name pool refuses a key it has never been shown
  (T-1502), so phases[].form.main_gable_cornice.note is declared `read`
  beside every other form note.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: polecat-steward <steward@polecat.live>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
